+def run_attempt(s, p, grasp_xyz):

+    q = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)  # closing axis is world -y at the frozen reset pose
+    x, y, z = grasp_xyz
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.20], q, speed=0.20, max_steps=180)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, z], q, speed=0.08, max_steps=180)
+    p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
+    # Raise well above the bin walls before translating.
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.34], q, speed=0.16, max_steps=200)
+    held_pose = s.objects()["spring_clamp"]["position"]
+    held = held_pose[2] > 0.12
+    print("AFTER_LIFT", grasp_xyz, held_pose, "held=", held, flush=True)
+    if not held:
+        return None
+    bx, by = s.objects()["right_bin"]["position"][:2]
+    p["move_ee"]([bx, by, 0.34], q, speed=0.18, max_steps=200)
+    # Put the object well inside the rim, then release it to the bin floor.
+    p["move_ee"]([bx, by, 0.060], q, speed=0.10, max_steps=200)
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=20)
+    p["hold"](steps=75)
+    return s.status()
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session(TASK, instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    clamp = s.objects()["spring_clamp"]["position"]
+    candidates = [
+        (clamp[0], clamp[1], 0.004),
+        (clamp[0] - 0.025, clamp[1], 0.004),
+        (clamp[0] + 0.025, clamp[1], 0.004),
+    ]
+    result = None
+    chosen = None
+    for xyz in candidates:
+        s.record_start()
+        try:
+            result = run_attempt(s, p, xyz)
+        except Exception as e:
+            print("ATTEMPT_ERROR", xyz, repr(e), flush=True)
+            result = None
+        actions = s.record_stop()
+        print("ATTEMPT_STATUS", result, "actions", len(actions), flush=True)
+        if result and result.get("success"):
